ns2:course.label: Intro to Differential Eq Plus
ns2:course.description: (MATH 286) Intended for engineering students and others who require a working knowledge of differential equations, included are techniques and applications of ordinary differential equations, linear systems of differential equations, and an introduction to partial differential equations. Credit not given for both MATH 386 and either MATH 385 or MATH 441 Prerequisite: MATH 242 or MATH 243, or equivalent.
